title: ep.commit_offset
description: Offset committed after one batch of one partition (EP-B2..B4). Each record carries its offset and whether it reached a disposition (`processed`, EP-B2). Reference (EP-B3): every record processed -> commit the offset after the last record; otherwise commit the offset after the highest processed record that lies below the lowest unprocessed record, or nothing when there is none. `pending_before` is ignored, so a later batch commits past unprocessed records of earlier batches (silent loss, EP-B4). Corrected (RBD-1): never commit past a record without a disposition: the lowest unprocessed offset is taken over the batch AND `pending_before`, so a pending earlier offset leaves nothing to commit. `commit` is the offset to commit (the next offset to read) or null = commit nothing.

processed.description: The record has a durable disposition (output produced, dead-lettered or intentionally dropped).

records.description: The batch's records of one partition, in offset order (offsets may have gaps).

pending_before.description: Offsets of earlier batches of the same partition still without a disposition.

commit.description: Offset to commit (next offset to read), or null = commit nothing.
